assembly_observation: The .009 assembly labels horizontal R33 above D39 and D34, and vertical C5 between those package outlines at package height; C82 is the separate neighboring vertical outline.
owner_observation: Two overlapping July owner photos and one May oblique close-up show a horizontal red axial body at the R33 assembly position above D39/D34. Its rotated marking is partial and cannot establish an isolated resistance. The inter-package strip at the C5 drawn height shows exposed copper and individual joints but no separate fitted capacitor body. The yellow molded body higher above D34 is at a different height and cannot be used as C5.
source_boundary: Exact .009 sheet 2 PXL_20260718_101911242.jpg prints R33=620 ohm and C5=560 (nominal pF by native bare-value convention) in the D34 pulse shaper. These source values do not prove what is fitted on the owner board.
decision: Retain R33=620 ohm and C5=560 pF as source circuit values. Treat the R33-position body as visibly fitted with a May body marking photo-consistent with 620 ohms but without isolated resistance measurement. Keep C5's owner population history and through-hole pair open; no separate body is visible at the factory position in the two July views or the May close-up. Do not infer factory DNP or assign the higher yellow body to C5.
next_inspection: Power off: meter R33-left/front gap joint (3098,2345)/solder (1110,2007) to D34.6 and D34.2 separately, and meter R33 right to ground/+5 V/D34.1 separately. Inspect the bare C5 site for cut, removal, or jumper; see r33-d34-pin6-source-conflict.json.
may_value_cross_check: In the independent May 19 oblique close-up, the R33-position red body rotated 180 degrees presents a marking that reads К62. Contemporary resistor notation uses K as the decimal marker in kilohms, so К62 denotes 0.62 kΩ = 620 ohms. The 1989 Soviet parts catalog also lists К62 (620 Ом). This visually corroborates the exact .009 R33=620 drawing, but no isolated resistance has been measured.
marking_reference: https://djvu.online/file/7ommtfONcYFYr (1989 Soviet radio-parts catalog: К62 = 620 Ом)
